name: Calm Coast
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Lily Flanagan's Pub (Babylon) - music calendar. Check the name and add a website or social page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Matched by name plus local context: the only Long Island act found with this name is Calm Coast Collective (also billed as Calm Coast Trio), the band of Long Island musician Christian Montanez, and it plays The Villager Farmingdale, a sister bar of Lily's Babylon. The Lily's listing itself does not link the band, so confidence is medium. The band has no separate website or social pages; website, booking form and social links are Christian Montanez's own (cmontymusic), which promote the band. Not the Apple Music "Calm Coast" (nature/relaxation sound singles). Consider renaming to "Calm Coast Collective" with "Calm Coast" and "Calm Coast Trio" as aliases.
description: Long Island party band led by singer and guitarist Christian Montanez, billed as a tropical party band. It plays popular cover songs at bars, weddings and private events, in sizes from a trio up to a full band with a horn section.
